comment: Human review of AWS service-model candidates. Read-style operations that return a credential-like member are sensitive unless listed under not_returned. manual_read_patterns cover AWS CLI read commands absent from service models. manual_patterns cover sensitive operations the models cannot show.

manual_read_patterns.*:wait: AWS CLI waiter commands poll until a modeled condition is met
manual_read_patterns.s3:ls: High-level S3 listing command is a customization absent from service models

not_returned.chime-sdk-identity:describe-app-instance: DeviceToken identifies a push-notification device; it grants no AWS access
not_returned.datasync:describe-location-fsx-ontap: Password sits in a shape shared with the create request; describe responses are not documented to return it
not_returned.datasync:describe-location-fsx-open-zfs: Password sits in a shape shared with the create request; describe responses are not documented to return it
not_returned.dms:describe-endpoints: Password members sit in settings shapes shared with create and modify; describe responses omit them
not_returned.ecs:describe-daemon-task-definition: repositoryCredentials holds a Secrets Manager or Parameter Store ARN, not the secret
not_returned.ecs:describe-task-definition: repositoryCredentials holds a Secrets Manager or Parameter Store ARN, not the secret
not_returned.fsx:describe-backups: FsxAdminPassword is a create and update input; describe responses omit it
not_returned.fsx:describe-file-systems: FsxAdminPassword is a create and update input; describe responses omit it
not_returned.fsx:describe-snapshots: FsxAdminPassword is a create and update input; describe responses omit it
not_returned.fsx:describe-volumes: FsxAdminPassword is a create and update input; describe responses omit it
not_returned.rds:describe-db-clusters: MasterUserPassword appears only in pending-change shapes shared with modify; responses never carry it
not_returned.rds:describe-db-instances: MasterUserPassword appears only in pending-change shapes shared with modify; responses never carry it
not_returned.rds:describe-tenant-databases: MasterUserPassword appears only in pending-change shapes shared with modify; responses never carry it
not_returned.redshift:describe-clusters: MasterUserPassword appears only in pending-change shapes shared with modify; responses never carry it

manual_patterns.codeartifact:get-authorization-token: The model does not mark its token sensitive
manual_patterns.ecr-public:get-authorization-token: The model does not mark its token sensitive
manual_patterns.ecr:get-authorization-token: The model does not mark its token sensitive
manual_patterns.ecr:get-login-password: A customization of the AWS CLI with no service-model operation
manual_patterns.eks:get-token: A customization of the AWS CLI with no service-model operation
manual_patterns.ssm:get-parameter*: Values are secret for SecureString parameters, and the model marks the member by name, not by type
